description: This file defines a controller class SubmitClaimController used within the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling claim submission functionality. It extends an abstract Vue controller, uses dependency injection to access a pay grade service, and sets up a Vue component with currency data during pre-render.

classes.name: SubmitClaimController
classes.description: Controller class for handling claim submission, extending AbstractVueController, utilizing services via traits, and preparing a Vue component with currency data.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Retrieves the PayGradeService instance from the service container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and a Vue component (with currency array) prior to rendering the claim submission page.
